description: This file defines a dependency function for FastAPI that extracts and verifies the current user based on the Authorization header containing a JWT token. It interacts with security verification, user data retrieval, and user profile schemas.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: A Pydantic schema representing the user's profile information.

methods.name: UserProfile get_current_user(authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None))
methods.description: Dependency function for FastAPI to decode JWT from Authorization header and obtain the current authenticated user's profile.
